name: menu
title: Menu
summary: A list of actions that opens from a button.
description: A list of actions that opens from a button. The raised popup scales out of its trigger and a single highlight glides between rows under the pointer and the arrow keys alike; opening and closing from the keyboard stay instant. Items can carry an icon and a trailing hint, be destructive, or be checkbox and radio options. Behaviour, focus and ARIA come from the Zag menu machine, through Ark UI in React, Vue and Svelte.

anatomy.description: Any button; aria-haspopup=menu, data-state=open|closed. The default trigger is the real Button (outline, sm) with a caret, marked data-menu="trigger"
Placed by the engine and rendered in a portal. Exposes --transform-origin and --available-height
role=menu popup; the shared popup surface (`lib/popup.ts`: surface, motion, keyboard-instant; stacking from base.css)
Shared gliding highlight layer (`glideLayer` of `lib/glide.ts`); glides under the pointer and the keyboard
Group heading; the shared option row's group label (`lib/option.ts`)

role=menuitem | menuitemcheckbox | menuitemradio; data-highlighted, data-state=checked|unchecked on options, data-disabled; composes the shared option row (`lib/option.ts`; the tone prop is its danger variant)

Leading icon of an action or a sub-menu row (the `icon` of the entry): the shared option row's icon (`lib/option.ts`), 14px glyph in ink-3, the row's red on a danger action; aria-hidden. React: a node (a Phosphor icon with data-slot="icon" weight="bold"); Vue and Svelte: an icon component, drawn bold. Checkbox and radio options lead with their control instead
Trailing hint, e.g. a keyboard shortcut; the shared option row's meta (`lib/option.ts`)
Ends a row that opens a sub-menu; a 12px caret (caret-right, mirrored under rtl) in ink-3, aria-hidden

Checkbox options lead with the checkbox's own control (data-slot=checkbox-control, the checkbox recipe's control classes, with its checkbox-mark), radio options with the radio's (data-slot=radio-group-control); data-state=checked|unchecked follows the option, so the mark is drawn exactly as in those components

items.label: string
items.icon: icon? (action, submenu; also an action inside a group). React: a node; Vue / Svelte: a component
items.name: string (radio-group)
items.closeOnSelect: boolean? (radio-group): close the menu when an option is picked; default false.

items.description: Entries in order: actions, checkbox options, groups with a label, radio groups, separators, and sub-menus: a row that opens a nested menu to its side. An action or a sub-menu row may lead with an icon; give icons to every action of a menu or to none, so the labels line up.

triggerLabel.description: Label of the default trigger. Pass your own trigger element instead when you need one (children / trigger slot / trigger snippet).

tone.description: Per item: danger marks a destructive action.

placement.description: Preferred side; flips when there is no room.

slots.trigger: Your own trigger element (React: children; Vue: trigger slot; Svelte: trigger snippet receiving the props to spread)

events.ui:set-open: No adapter handles it (control `open` instead). { open: boolean }
events.ui:set-checked: No adapter handles it. { value, checked } set a checkbox option without a checkedChange
events.ui:set-value: No adapter handles it. { name, value } set a radio group without a radioChange

keyboard: Enter / Space / ArrowDown on the trigger open the menu and move focus into it; ArrowUp opens on the last item
ArrowDown / ArrowUp move the highlight; Home / End jump
Typing jumps to the matching item (type-ahead)
Enter / Space activate the highlighted item; checkbox and radio options toggle

On a sub-menu row: ArrowRight (ArrowLeft under rtl), Enter or Space open the sub-menu on its first item; ArrowLeft (ArrowRight under rtl) or Escape close it and return to the row. Hovering the row opens it
Escape closes; focus returns to the trigger. Tab closes and moves on
notes: An icon-only trigger needs an aria-label.
Opening and closing from the keyboard are instant; the highlight glides under the pointer and the keyboard alike.

motion: popup: the shared popup surface (`lib/popup.ts`): opacity + scale from motion.popup-scale out of the trigger (--transform-origin), duration.popup, easing.out-strong; closes at duration.fast; instant when opened or closed from the keyboard

mounted open (defaultOpen, or open at mount): the popup is drawn at once, with no entrance (menu-content carries data-mounted-open until it first closes); its close, and every later open, animate as above

sub-menu: the same popup, growing from the row that opened it; its first row on the same line as that row, its edge 4px clear of the parent panel; that row keeps the highlight while the sub-menu is open
highlight: one layer glides between rows over duration.move, easing.out-strong, under the pointer and the arrow keys alike
rows: a pressed row darkens to color.hover-2 over duration.fast
checkbox and radio options: the checkbox's and the radio's own mark recipe (the fill leads, the mark is drawn); instant from the keyboard
items: no entrance animation and no stagger (a menu is opened many times a day)
